tools.name: krom_route_workflow
tools.title: Route KROM Forge workflow
tools.description: Classify a substantial product/software request and return relevant KROM Forge skills, evidence sources, and deliverables.

tools.name: krom_create_research_brief
tools.title: Create domain research brief
tools.description: Create a rigorous research plan before product requirements or prompt synthesis. This plans research; it does not claim research was performed.
tools.inputSchemaExpression:
z.object({
        domain: z.string().min(2),
        productGoal: z.string().min(3),
        industry: z.string().optional(),
        jurisdiction: z.string().optional(),
        knownConstraints: z.array(z.string()).default([])
      })

tools.name: krom_create_master_prompt_blueprint
tools.title: Create master prompt blueprint
tools.description: Create an implementation-grade coding-agent prompt structure from product objectives and researched findings.
tools.inputSchemaExpression:
z.object({
        product: z.string().min(2),
        objective: z.string().min(3),
        researchedFindings: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        targetUsers: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        constraints: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        existingProject: z.boolean().default(false)
      })

tools.name: krom_create_uiux_blueprint
tools.title: Create high-fidelity UI/UX blueprint
tools.description: Create a concrete UI/UX specification with hierarchy, tokens, interaction states, responsive reflow, RTL/LTR, accessibility and visual verification.
tools.inputSchemaExpression:
z.object({
        product: z.string().min(2),
        primaryUsers: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        screens: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        bilingualArabicEnglish: z.boolean().default(false),
        styleDirection: z.string().optional()
      })

tools.name: krom_create_engineering_blueprint
tools.title: Create full-stack engineering blueprint
tools.description: Create architecture guidance for data, APIs, auth, concurrency, integrations, observability, testing, performance, deployment and rollback.
tools.inputSchemaExpression:
z.object({
        product: z.string().min(2),
        stack: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        realtime: z.boolean().default(false),
        uploads: z.boolean().default(false),
        multiTenant: z.boolean().default(false),
        externalIntegrations: z.array(z.string()).default([])
      })

tools.name: krom_create_debug_plan
tools.title: Create root-cause debug plan
tools.description: Create an evidence-first debugging plan from a concrete error or broken behavior.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_release_evidence
tools.title: Evaluate release evidence
tools.description: Evaluate supplied release evidence without inventing missing passes.

tools.name: krom_select_tools
tools.title: Select host tools and evidence sources
tools.description: Determine the minimum sufficient host-authorized tools needed for a request. This does not call those tools; it creates an explicit evidence plan and reports unavailable capabilities when the host supplies an availability list.

tools.name: krom_build_task_graph
tools.title: Build engineering task graph
tools.description: Convert an engineering objective into dependency-aware INSPECT → RESEARCH → PLAN → IMPLEMENT → VERIFY → RELEASE tasks with evidence and acceptance requirements.

tools.name: krom_plan_execution
tools.title: Create portable KROM run state
tools.description: Create a stateless, portable engineering run state that a host can persist and return later for continuation. It tracks dependencies, current task, assumptions, blockers and evidence without pretending the server has durable memory.

tools.name: krom_resume_task
tools.title: Resume a portable KROM run
tools.description: Update a previously returned KROM run state with completed/failed tasks, blockers and evidence; unlock dependency-ready tasks and return the next task.

tools.name: krom_verify_evidence
tools.title: Verify completion claims against supplied evidence
tools.description: Evaluate whether engineering claims have sufficient supplied evidence. Missing evidence remains explicitly UNVERIFIED; this tool never invents a pass.

tools.name: krom_audit_project
tools.title: Audit supplied project inventory
tools.description: Perform a conservative project audit from host-supplied inventory. It identifies evidence gaps and risks without claiming to have inspected files that were not supplied.
tools.inputSchemaExpression:
z.object({
        projectType: z.string().optional(),
        files: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        scripts: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        routes: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        knownErrors: z.array(z.string()).default([]),
        hasTests: z.boolean().optional(),
        hasAuth: z.boolean().optional(),
        hasDatabase: z.boolean().optional()
      })

tools.name: krom_inspect_project
tools.title: Inspect real project snapshot
tools.description: Analyze a host-supplied project snapshot and return inventory, architecture, dependencies, route risks, duplicate candidates and prioritized project risks. KROM Forge analyzes only supplied evidence and never pretends it directly read unsupplied files.

tools.name: krom_build_project_inventory
tools.title: Build project inventory
tools.description: Normalize a host-supplied project snapshot into framework/language/file/route/dependency/script/Git evidence and report evidence completeness.

tools.name: krom_map_architecture
tools.title: Map project architecture
tools.description: Infer project modules and trust boundaries from supplied files and metadata while explicitly reporting architecture evidence gaps.

tools.name: krom_inventory_dependencies
tools.title: Inventory project dependencies
tools.description: Classify supplied package dependencies into framework/UI/database/auth/testing/build/observability groups and flag overlapping dependency families for review.

tools.name: krom_detect_broken_routes
tools.title: Detect broken or suspect routes
tools.description: Correlate supplied route inventory, backing files and diagnostics to identify broken or suspect routes. Runtime success still requires browser or execution evidence.

tools.name: krom_detect_duplicates
tools.title: Detect duplicate project artifacts
tools.description: Identify exact duplicate files when host-supplied hashes exist and identify filename collisions that require human/host review. Name similarity alone is never treated as proof of duplication.

tools.name: krom_find_risks
tools.title: Find project risks
tools.description: Prioritize build, test, Git-state, database, auth, RLS, diagnostics and evidence gaps from a supplied project snapshot.

tools.name: krom_compare_project_state
tools.title: Compare project state before and after changes
tools.description: Compare two host-supplied project snapshots for added/removed/hashed-changed files, route/diagnostic counts, and build/test evidence without inventing unsupplied changes.

tools.name: krom_classify_sources
tools.title: Classify research sources
tools.description: Classify host-supplied research evidence by authority and evidence class without claiming that KROM Forge independently browsed the source.

tools.name: krom_extract_requirements
tools.title: Extract evidence-backed requirements
tools.description: Extract explicit requirements from host-supplied source claims, preserving evidence class, confidence, source ID and unresolved validation needs.

tools.name: krom_build_domain_model
tools.title: Build domain model from research
tools.description: Synthesize actors, entities, workflows, controls and assumptions from host-supplied research evidence. This is synthesis, not independent browsing.

tools.name: krom_detect_research_conflicts
tools.title: Detect research conflicts
tools.description: Heuristically identify potentially conflicting supplied claims that require source or human review before product synthesis.

tools.name: krom_assess_research_coverage
tools.title: Assess research coverage
tools.description: Check whether supplied research evidence has sufficient authoritative coverage, explicit requirements and constraints for synthesis.

tools.name: krom_synthesize_research
tools.title: Synthesize research evidence
tools.description: Produce a combined evidence classification, requirement set, domain model, conflict review and research-readiness decision from host-supplied evidence.

tools.name: krom_plan_code_change
tools.title: Plan a code change
tools.description: Create a smallest-coherent-diff implementation plan from a host-supplied patch request, including impact, scope, preconditions and evidence requirements.

tools.name: krom_prepare_patch
tools.title: Prepare host-executable patch contract
tools.description: Create a patch contract for an authorized host to apply. KROM Forge does not claim to mutate files itself.

tools.name: krom_validate_change_scope
tools.title: Validate patch scope
tools.description: Check proposed file changes against explicit allowed and forbidden path rules and block scope creep.

tools.name: krom_assess_patch_risk
tools.title: Assess patch risk
tools.description: Assess change risk from touched files, deletions, database impact, auth impact, deployment impact and scope clarity.

tools.name: krom_generate_migration_plan
tools.title: Generate database migration safety plan
tools.description: Generate a conservative migration/rollback plan when a patch may change schema or data. UNKNOWN database impact remains a blocker.

tools.name: krom_generate_test_plan
tools.title: Generate proportional test plan
tools.description: Generate required type/build/focused/UI/API/database/auth/regression gates from the declared patch scope and impacts.

tools.name: krom_review_diff
tools.title: Review host-applied diff
tools.description: Review host-supplied changed files, diagnostics, build evidence and test evidence; report scope violations and verification gaps.

tools.name: krom_verify_patch_evidence
tools.title: Verify patch evidence
tools.description: Verify patch-level claims against supplied diff/build/test/diagnostic evidence without inventing a pass.

tools.name: krom_list_agents
tools.title: List KROM specialist agents
tools.description: Return the v29 specialist-agent contracts, ownership boundaries, required inputs, outputs, preferred host tools and release-blocking authority.

tools.name: krom_route_agent
tools.title: Route objective to specialist agents
tools.description: Select a dependency-aware specialist-agent sequence for an objective without pretending any agent has executed work.

tools.name: krom_create_agent_run
tools.title: Create portable multi-agent run
tools.description: Create a portable multi-agent coordination state with ordered specialist contracts, evidence requirements and dependencies.

tools.name: krom_agent_handoff
tools.title: Create and validate agent handoff
tools.description: Normalize the STATUS / CHANGES / EVIDENCE / RISKS / OPEN_ITEMS / NEXT_AGENT contract and reject unsupported PASS claims.

tools.name: krom_coordinate_agents
tools.title: Coordinate specialist handoffs
tools.description: Evaluate a sequence of specialist handoffs, identify invalid contracts or blockers, and determine the next coordination action.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_agent_run
tools.title: Evaluate multi-agent run evidence
tools.description: Evaluate handoff integrity, blockers, gaps, verified evidence and independent release-auditor presence without fabricating a green status.

tools.name: krom_create_project_memory
tools.title: Create project intelligence memory
tools.description: Create an isolated project-memory object. PORTABLE mode is host-carried; EXTERNAL_PERSISTENCE is only a persistence contract until an authorized durable store is connected.

tools.name: krom_get_project_memory
tools.title: Summarize project intelligence memory
tools.description: Summarize the current project memory, blockers, risks, failing tests and latest deployment without claiming durable persistence.

tools.name: krom_update_project_memory
tools.title: Update project intelligence memory
tools.description: Update version, commit, architecture summary or notes while preserving project scope and historical records.

tools.name: krom_record_decision
tools.title: Record project decision
tools.description: Upsert an architecture/product/engineering decision into project-scoped memory with evidence references.

tools.name: krom_record_failure
tools.title: Record project failure
tools.description: Record or update a concrete build/type/test/runtime/database/auth/deployment failure and its resolution state.

tools.name: krom_record_evidence
tools.title: Record project evidence
tools.description: Record evidence such as source, build, test, diff, runtime, deployment, security, database or browser evidence.

tools.name: krom_record_test_result
tools.title: Record test result
tools.description: Record deterministic or browser test evidence without converting NOT_RUN or FAIL into a pass.

tools.name: krom_record_deployment
tools.title: Record deployment
tools.description: Record deployment identity, environment, URL, commit/version and evidence-backed status.

tools.name: krom_record_task
tools.title: Record project task
tools.description: Record or update a project task, priority, owner, blockers and linked evidence.

tools.name: krom_record_risk
tools.title: Record project risk
tools.description: Record or update a project risk, severity, mitigation and evidence references.

tools.name: krom_record_project_snapshot
tools.title: Record project snapshot
tools.description: Record a lightweight architecture/project-state snapshot for later comparison.

tools.name: krom_get_project_timeline
tools.title: Get project intelligence timeline
tools.description: Build a chronological timeline strictly from records already present in project memory.

tools.name: krom_compare_project_memory
tools.title: Compare project memory states
tools.description: Compare two memory states for the same project/scope and report record/version/architecture deltas.

tools.name: krom_audit_project_memory
tools.title: Audit project memory integrity
tools.description: Check duplicate IDs, dangling evidence references and whether durable-persistence claims are permitted by the supplied storage mode.

tools.name: krom_audit_ui
tools.title: Audit UI/UX from host evidence
tools.description: Audit host-supplied rendered/UI observations for hierarchy, consistency, interaction states and high-severity usability defects without pretending KROM opened a browser.

tools.name: krom_audit_responsive
tools.title: Audit responsive behavior
tools.description: Evaluate host-supplied viewport evidence for structural reflow, navigation, tables, dialogs, drawers and mobile usability.

tools.name: krom_audit_rtl
tools.title: Audit RTL behavior
tools.description: Evaluate supplied RTL evidence for navigation, logical layout, mixed text, tables, forms and direction-sensitive controls.

tools.name: krom_audit_accessibility
tools.title: Audit accessibility evidence
tools.description: Evaluate supplied accessibility-tree, keyboard and UI findings; absence of accessibility evidence is reported as a verification gap.

tools.name: krom_build_design_system
tools.title: Build design-system contract
tools.description: Create a concrete token/component/state/RTL contract for implementation; does not claim the product already implements it.

tools.name: krom_review_ui_evidence
tools.title: Review UI verification evidence
tools.description: Assess whether supplied browser/screenshot/DOM/accessibility observations are sufficient to support UI quality claims.

tools.name: krom_compare_ui_states
tools.title: Compare UI evidence states
tools.description: Compare before/after UI observation snapshots to identify resolved findings, new findings and high-severity regressions.

tools.name: krom_generate_ui_fix_plan
tools.title: Generate evidence-backed UI fix plan
tools.description: Turn UI findings into route-scoped implementation and verification work while preserving explicit allowed paths.

tools.name: krom_create_debug_session
tools.title: Create evidence-driven debug session
tools.description: Create a structured debugging session for one concrete symptom without claiming reproduction or root cause.

tools.name: krom_classify_failure
tools.title: Classify debugging failure
tools.description: Classify a debug session from supplied symptom/error/evidence into code, config, data, permission, environment, dependency, deployment, UI, integration, database, auth, network or performance categories.

tools.name: krom_add_debug_evidence
tools.title: Add debugging evidence
tools.description: Add or update a concrete evidence item in a debug session. Verified must only be true when the host actually observed the artifact.

tools.name: krom_add_debug_hypothesis
tools.title: Add falsifiable debug hypothesis
tools.description: Add a hypothesis linked to supporting/contradicting evidence and explicit predictions.

tools.name: krom_record_debug_attempt
tools.title: Record diagnostic or fix attempt
tools.description: Record one diagnostic/fix attempt and outcome so repeated failed strategies can be detected.

tools.name: krom_update_reproduction
tools.title: Update reproduction contract
tools.description: Record exact reproduction status, steps, expected vs actual behavior and evidence references.

tools.name: krom_build_root_cause_graph
tools.title: Build root-cause evidence graph
tools.description: Build a graph linking symptom, hypotheses, evidence and confirmed/probable root cause without inventing causality.

tools.name: krom_check_debug_loop
tools.title: Check anti-loop debugging policy
tools.description: Detect repeated failed/inconclusive strategies and require new evidence or a changed hypothesis after repeated attempts.

tools.name: krom_next_debug_diagnostic
tools.title: Recommend next debugging diagnostic
tools.description: Choose the next evidence-producing action: reproduce, collect evidence, disprove hypothesis, change strategy, plan smallest fix or verify.

tools.name: krom_set_root_cause
tools.title: Set evidence-linked root cause
tools.description: Record UNKNOWN/PROBABLE/CONFIRMED root cause with explicit evidence references.

tools.name: krom_record_debug_fix
tools.title: Record debugging fix
tools.description: Record the planned/applied/reverted smallest coherent fix, changed paths and evidence references.

tools.name: krom_verify_debug_fix
tools.title: Record focused and regression verification
tools.description: Record focused, regression, runtime and browser verification results with evidence references.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_debug_closure
tools.title: Evaluate debug closure evidence
tools.description: Prevent a false FIXED claim unless root cause, applied fix and verification are supported by verified evidence with no blockers.

tools.name: krom_create_evidence_bundle
tools.title: Create claim-evidence bundle
tools.description: Create a project-scoped claim/evidence graph for evidence-backed engineering assertions.

tools.name: krom_record_claim
tools.title: Record evidence-backed claim
tools.description: Record or update a claim such as build passed, fixed, deployed, UI verified or a custom assertion without treating it as supported yet.

tools.name: krom_record_evidence_artifact
tools.title: Record evidence artifact
tools.description: Record host-supplied evidence with kind, source, summary and explicit verified flag.

tools.name: krom_link_claim_evidence
tools.title: Link claim to evidence
tools.description: Link an existing claim to existing evidence artifacts; unknown references are rejected.

tools.name: krom_verify_claim
tools.title: Verify claim against evidence
tools.description: Evaluate one claim against verified linked evidence and return SUPPORTED, PARTIAL, UNSUPPORTED or CONTRADICTED.

tools.name: krom_audit_evidence_graph
tools.title: Audit evidence graph integrity
tools.description: Audit dangling references, unsupported claims, contradictions and unverified artifacts.

tools.name: krom_build_release_evidence
tools.title: Build release evidence gates
tools.description: Derive build/test/deployment release gates strictly from recorded evidence-backed claims.

tools.name: krom_compare_evidence_snapshots
tools.title: Compare evidence snapshots
tools.description: Compare two claim/evidence bundles from the same project scope and report status/evidence changes.

tools.name: krom_create_autonomous_loop
tools.title: Create autonomous engineering loop
tools.description: Create a resumable engineering state machine that coordinates inspection, research, planning, specialist agents, patching, debugging, UI/UX verification, evidence and release without pretending the host executed unavailable tools.

tools.name: krom_get_next_autonomous_action
tools.title: Get next autonomous engineering action
tools.description: Return the next step, required host-authorized tools and evidence needed for the current loop state.

tools.name: krom_advance_autonomous_loop
tools.title: Advance autonomous engineering loop
tools.description: Advance or retry a loop step using explicit completion/failure updates, blockers and evidence; retry budget prevents blind loops.

tools.name: krom_record_loop_host_result
tools.title: Record host execution result
tools.description: Record the result of an authorized host action, attach verified evidence and advance or block the current loop step accordingly.

tools.name: krom_resume_autonomous_loop
tools.title: Resume autonomous engineering loop
tools.description: Summarize a portable loop state and identify the exact next action after interruption or handoff.

tools.name: krom_audit_autonomous_loop
tools.title: Audit autonomous engineering loop
tools.description: Audit progress, retry exhaustion, blockers and evidence support; release cannot pass while consequential completed steps lack verified evidence.

tools.name: krom_register_host_capabilities
tools.title: Register host capability snapshot
tools.description: Normalize and summarize the capabilities the current ChatGPT/Codex/custom MCP host actually exposes. KROM does not discover tools by magic; the host supplies this evidence-backed snapshot.

tools.name: krom_assess_host_requirements
tools.title: Assess host capability requirements
tools.description: Check required operations/evidence against a supplied host capability snapshot and return EXECUTABLE, DEGRADED or BLOCKED without simulating missing tools.

tools.name: krom_adapt_loop_to_host
tools.title: Adapt autonomous loop to host
tools.description: Map an autonomous engineering loop onto the actual host capabilities. Steps with unavailable tools are explicitly blocked rather than fabricated.

tools.name: krom_recommend_host_strategy
tools.title: Recommend host-aware execution strategy
tools.description: Map an objective to the capabilities available in the current host and explicitly report gaps.

tools.name: krom_validate_host_evidence
tools.title: Validate host evidence capability
tools.description: Check whether the host can actually produce requested evidence kinds; unsupported evidence remains a gap.

tools.name: krom_compare_host_capabilities
tools.title: Compare host capability snapshots
tools.description: Compare two host snapshots to detect added, removed or changed tools/capabilities between ChatGPT/Codex/custom host sessions.

tools.name: krom_get_execution_policy
tools.title: Get execution policy
tools.description: Return the default v36 execution/approval policy. Read-only analysis can be auto-executable; consequential mutations require explicit approval or remain blocked.

tools.name: krom_classify_execution_action
tools.title: Classify execution action
tools.description: Classify a proposed action as AUTO_EXECUTE, REQUIRE_APPROVAL or BLOCKED using action impact, reversibility, environment and host capability evidence.

tools.name: krom_create_approval_request
tools.title: Create approval request
tools.description: Create an action-scoped approval request for a consequential operation. This does not grant approval.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_approval
tools.title: Evaluate execution approval
tools.description: Check whether a specific action is allowed to execute using the policy and an action-scoped approval record. Missing, denied or mismatched approval blocks execution.

tools.name: krom_enforce_execution_policy
tools.title: Enforce execution policy
tools.description: Evaluate a batch of proposed actions and return only those currently allowed. Consequential actions remain pending until valid explicit approvals are supplied.

tools.name: krom_audit_execution_policy
tools.title: Audit execution policy state
tools.description: Audit action classifications, approvals, high-risk pending actions and orphan approvals without treating silence as consent.

tools.name: krom_compare_execution_policies
tools.title: Compare execution policies
tools.description: Compare two execution policies to detect changes in auto-execute, approval and blocked action classes.

tools.name: krom_get_quality_gate_policy
tools.title: Get quality gate policy
tools.description: Return the v37 quality gate dimensions and hard-stop rules used before DONE or RELEASE_READY may be claimed.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_plan_quality
tools.title: Evaluate engineering plan quality
tools.description: Evaluate dependency integrity, acceptance criteria, evidence requirements, assumptions and risk coverage before implementation begins.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_quality_gate
tools.title: Evaluate project quality gate
tools.description: Evaluate weighted quality dimensions, blockers, unsupported claims and residual risks. Critical gaps prevent RELEASE_READY.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_delivery_quality
tools.title: Evaluate final delivery quality
tools.description: Audit the final delivery summary, completed items, evidence references, known gaps and user-facing claims before handoff.

tools.name: krom_self_critique
tools.title: Run KROM self-critique
tools.description: Perform a conservative self-review over plan, execution, evidence, blockers and residual risks without converting missing proof into success.

tools.name: krom_compare_quality_gates
tools.title: Compare quality gate snapshots
tools.description: Compare before/after quality snapshots and quantify whether remediation actually improved the evidence-backed gate result.

tools.name: krom_create_restore_point
tools.title: Create recovery restore point
tools.description: Normalize a host-supplied restore point and flag whether it is evidence-backed before any rollback plan relies on it.

tools.name: krom_assess_recovery_impact
tools.title: Assess recovery blast radius
tools.description: Assess production impact, data-loss risk, downtime risk, affected areas and irreversible steps before recovery actions are planned.

tools.name: krom_build_recovery_plan
tools.title: Build rollback or recovery plan
tools.description: Build and validate an evidence-aware recovery plan with approvals, preconditions, abort conditions and post-recovery checks.

tools.name: krom_validate_recovery_execution
tools.title: Validate recovery execution state
tools.description: Validate host-reported recovery step results, approvals and evidence. PASS without required evidence is rejected.

tools.name: krom_verify_recovery
tools.title: Verify recovery result
tools.description: Verify target state, service health, data integrity and post-recovery checks before claiming rollback or recovery succeeded.

tools.name: krom_recommend_recovery_strategy
tools.title: Recommend recovery strategy
tools.description: Recommend roll-forward, code/deployment rollback, database restore or manual recovery review from supplied impact evidence.

tools.name: krom_compare_restore_points
tools.title: Compare restore points
tools.description: Compare two restore points to detect source, environment and evidence changes.

tools.name: krom_normalize_runtime_signals
tools.title: Normalize runtime signals
tools.description: Normalize host-supplied logs, metrics, traces, health checks and runtime events into a verified observability snapshot.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_service_health
tools.title: Evaluate service health
tools.description: Evaluate service health only from verified host-supplied telemetry and required checks. Missing evidence yields INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE rather than healthy.

tools.name: krom_detect_runtime_anomalies
tools.title: Detect runtime anomalies
tools.description: Detect verified severity, threshold and baseline-deviation anomalies without treating heuristics as root-cause proof.

tools.name: krom_correlate_runtime_incident
tools.title: Correlate runtime incident evidence
tools.description: Correlate verified runtime failures with deployment/change/debug references while explicitly avoiding unsupported causation claims.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_slo
tools.title: Evaluate SLO status
tools.description: Calculate observed service level and error-budget consumption from supplied event counts.

tools.name: krom_build_runtime_evidence
tools.title: Build runtime evidence artifacts
tools.description: Convert runtime signals into evidence artifacts consumable by debugging, recovery, evidence and quality-gate workflows.

tools.name: krom_recommend_runtime_action
tools.title: Recommend runtime response
tools.description: Recommend evidence collection, debugging, recovery review or continued monitoring from verified runtime signals.

tools.name: krom_compare_runtime_snapshots
tools.title: Compare runtime snapshots
tools.description: Compare before/after verified runtime error and critical-signal counts to support recovery and release verification.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_production_readiness
tools.title: Evaluate production readiness
tools.description: Aggregate quality, evidence, security, runtime, recovery, approval, deployment and data gates into an evidence-backed production-readiness assessment.

tools.name: krom_decide_release
tools.title: Decide release control state
tools.description: Return READY, CONDITIONAL or BLOCKED using hard stops, weighted readiness, approvals and explicit exception policy.

tools.name: krom_build_release_checklist
tools.title: Build production release checklist
tools.description: Build a complete release checklist across build, tests, security, evidence, runtime, recovery, quality, approval, deployment and data.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_release_exception
tools.title: Evaluate release exception
tools.description: Validate an explicit release exception record with approver, compensating controls and evidence without converting failed gates into PASS.

tools.name: krom_verify_post_release
tools.title: Verify production release
tools.description: Verify deployment, healthy runtime, regression checks, incidents and evidence after release before closing the release.

tools.name: krom_create_release_control_summary
tools.title: Create release control summary
tools.description: Create one control-plane summary combining readiness assessment and operational release checklist.

tools.name: krom_compare_production_readiness
tools.title: Compare production readiness
tools.description: Compare before/after production readiness scores, hard stops and warnings to show whether remediation improved release state.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_security_assessment
tools.title: Evaluate security assessment
tools.description: Evaluate evidence-backed security findings and controls; critical gaps or missing controls block a secure release claim.

tools.name: krom_audit_rls
tools.title: Audit database RLS evidence
tools.description: Audit host-supplied RLS enablement, policies and negative access tests. Missing evidence is a gap, not a pass.

tools.name: krom_audit_authorization
tools.title: Audit authorization evidence
tools.description: Audit server-side authorization and negative permission tests for protected resources.

tools.name: krom_audit_secrets
tools.title: Audit secret exposure evidence
tools.description: Detect secret-like material reported in source, logs or client bundles without reproducing secret values.

tools.name: krom_audit_dependencies_security
tools.title: Audit dependency security evidence
tools.description: Summarize host-supplied dependency advisory severities; unknown or high-risk findings remain explicit gaps.

tools.name: krom_build_security_control_matrix
tools.title: Build security control matrix
tools.description: Map security controls to verification status and evidence coverage for release control.

tools.name: krom_recommend_security_remediation
tools.title: Recommend security remediation order
tools.description: Prioritize open security findings by severity and define verification-oriented remediation steps.

tools.name: krom_compare_security_assessments
tools.title: Compare security assessments
tools.description: Compare before/after open security findings and gate state to show verified remediation progress.

tools.name: krom_evaluate_compliance_assessment
tools.title: Evaluate compliance assessment
tools.description: Evaluate obligations with source authority, applicability, status and verified evidence. Mandatory requirements cannot be inferred from guidance, benchmarks or assumptions.

tools.name: krom_map_compliance_evidence
tools.title: Map compliance evidence
tools.description: Map each requirement to linked and verified evidence artifacts and expose coverage gaps.

tools.name: krom_build_compliance_control_coverage
tools.title: Build compliance control coverage
